fixes.explanation: Yes, baker, it's their children. Verse 7 says, "Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD." The gladness isn't kept to one generation. The kids get to watch it happen, and I think that's a gift for the whole family.

Right, baker, that's what the LORD says. "The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart." Assyria's pride comes down and Egypt's scepter leaves. Those two names come up again after the LORD said He'd gather His people from Assyria and bring them back from Egypt.

Not in this verse, friend. The LORD says, "The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart." Nobody joins and no gates open. An army signing up would be a big plot twist, but pride that just got brought down isn't in the mood to show up with a welcome banner.
